title: Formal unramifiedness of a morphism of algebraic spaces is detected on etale charts
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms of Spaces)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file spaces-more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma characterises formal unramifiedness of a morphism of algebraic spaces through etale charts: the morphism is formally unramified exactly when every chart morphism between schemes is, and it suffices to test one chart with surjective vertical arrows. The proof passes to a chart, applies the schemes-side criterion for the chart morphism, and then descends using that formal unramifiedness is etale local on the source and target. The descent through the chart is the load-bearing step. Retained author proof at lines 2745-2780.
